title: The Stolen Starlight

intro.title: A wish in the woods
intro.text: Jon found a fallen star beneath an ancient oak. Its fading light whispered of a kingdom hidden above the clouds.

intro.title: One enchanted seed
intro.text: With a flick of his crystal staff, Jon planted a silver bean. A living staircase of leaves unfurled into the sky.

intro.title: The Giant awakens
intro.text: High above, the Giant clutched the stolen starlight. Jon must cross three enchanted realms before the last spark fades.

levels.name: Whispering Grove
levels.description: Learn the rhythm of the living vines.

levels.name: Cloudbound Crossing
levels.description: Mossy stones guard the path above the clouds.

levels.name: The Starkeeper's Gate
levels.description: Find the open vine and reclaim the starlight.

outro: Jon raised his staff. The stolen stars returned to the night, and the beanstalk bloomed with a thousand tiny lights.
